creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-09 on 0.24.0, devenv panes in a laptop window. A lead agent posted a short instruction (#7) to a builder pane that sat idle, waiting on its own reviewers. The wake never rang. 27 minutes later @muster told the lead: "a wake for it is held because its prompt is not on its screen, which is 41x83 and may be too short to show it". The builder was idle all that time. A `muster pane send` nudge reached it at once, so the agent could take input; only the doorbell's check of its screen failed.

The builder was a split made with `muster pane new --pane <lead>` in a window that already held several panes, so it came out 41 columns wide and 83 rows tall. The notice's guess, "too short", does not fit a pane that tall; narrow is what it was. a_2izzXOqQF made this notice name the prompt and the pane's size instead of blaming a draft; here the notice came only after 27 minutes and named no way through.

Possibly: for an agent whose harness reports it idle, ring without requiring its prompt on screen. Failing that, tell the sender within a minute or two, say narrow or short as the size shows, and name `pane send` as the fallback.
title: A wake to an idle agent in a narrow pane was held for 27 minutes
